paragraphs.text: Kaheera , the Orphanguard is a legendary cat beast from the plane of Ikoria .

When a human hunter slays a monster, they usually leave that monster's offspring to fend for themselves. Kaheera seems driven by instinct to protect any and all young it comes across, and it raises its diverse brood (formed by monsters from every dominant clade of Ikoria) as its own.
Kaheera fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
